subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A strong voice does not always need to be loud.”?
options: Sometimes they only need a different purpose.
Sometimes silence, arranged carefully, can speak clearly.
Sometimes it only needs to be honest.
It needs to be clear, honest, and followed by better care next time.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes they only need a different purpose.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes silence, arranged carefully, can speak clearly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A strong voice does not always need to be loud. Sometimes it only needs to be honest.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A strong voice does not always need to be loud. Sometimes it only needs to be honest.」，答案為「Sometimes it only needs to be honest.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Sometimes it only needs to be honest.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
